name: MinersActivityChart
description: Per-status miner counts (online / offline / faulted / power-mode). Renders as coloured indicator dots (`indicators`) or tinted status tiles (`tiles`)

props.name: variant
props.description: `indicators` (default) renders coloured dots; `tiles` renders tinted status tiles

fields.name: total
fields.description: Total miner count; not rendered, since each tile reads its own status key (e.g. `offline`, `error`, `sleep`) and shows…
fields.descriptionFull: Total miner count; not rendered, since each tile reads its own status key (e.g. `offline`, `error`, `sleep`) and shows 0 when absent

fields.name: data
fields.description: Error payload; `message` becomes the error alert description when `isError` is set, else a generic retry hint
